title: Demonstrates Commitment to Integrity and Ethical Values
description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values through published codes of conduct and executive governance.
notes: Code of Business Conduct signed by all personnel upon onboarding and recertified annually.

title: Internal and External Communication of Security Objectives
description: The entity communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
notes: Quarterly all-hands security briefings and company-wide GRC wiki updates.

title: Risk Assessment and Threat Identification
description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.
notes: Annual formal enterprise risk assessment documented in the central Risk Register.

title: Control Activities and Technology Infrastructure
description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
notes: Automated CI/CD security controls and infrastructure-as-code linting.

title: Logical Access Security & Identity Management
description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.
notes: Enforces 14-character passwords, MFA via Okta/Google Workspace, and automated quarterly access reviews.

title: User Registration and Access Provisioning
description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users.
notes: HR onboarding workflows automate account provisioning based on least-privilege role matrices.

title: Revocation of Access Upon Termination
description: The entity revokes access credentials and privileges upon termination of employment or contractor engagements within established SLAs.
notes: SaaS and cloud access automatically disabled within 4 hours of offboarding notification.

title: Boundary Protection & Network Segmentation
description: The entity implements logical boundaries and network segmentation controls to prevent unauthorized perimeter access.
notes: Perimeter protected by AWS WAF and CloudFront. TLS 1.3 enforced for customer ingress.

title: Data Transmission Encryption & Key Management
description: The entity protects data in transit and at rest using cryptographic keys managed under strict rotation lifecycles.
notes: TLS 1.2+ mandatory on all load balancers; KMS annual automatic key rotation enabled.

title: Vulnerability Infrastructure Scanning & Penetration Testing
description: The entity conducts continuous vulnerability assessments and external penetration tests against cloud infrastructure.
notes: Annual external penetration testing identified 2 medium severity findings undergoing remediation.

title: Security Incident Detection & Monitoring
description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of controls to detect anomalies and unauthorized actions.
notes: Centralized CloudTrail and GuardDuty alerts routed to #security-incidents in Slack.

title: Incident Triage and Mitigation Execution
description: The entity evaluates and acts on detected security incidents to determine their scope and contain damage.
notes: Incident Response Plan tested through tabletop exercises in Q1.

title: Change Management and Authorized Code Deployment
description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure and data.
notes: GitHub branch protection mandates peer approvals and automated green CI tests before production release.

title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Testing
description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover operations following disruptive security events.
notes: Multi-AZ automated RDS backups and annual recovery test met RTO < 2 hrs and RPO < 15 mins.

title: Policies for Information Security
description: Information security policies and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, and communicated to employees.
notes: Suite of 10 formal security policies published on corporate portal.

title: Access Control and Privileged Rights
description: Access to physical and logical assets shall be controlled based on business and security requirements.
notes: Least privilege RBAC audited quarterly across AWS, Google Workspace, and GitHub.

title: Screening and Pre-Employment Background Checks
description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.
notes: Third-party criminal and identity checks conducted for 100% of hires.

title: User Endpoint Devices and Mobile Security
description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected with MDM and full-disk encryption.
notes: All corporate Mac and Windows endpoints managed with automatic OS patch enforcement.

title: Protection Against Malware and Ransomware
description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
notes: Next-gen endpoint detection and response (EDR) active with real-time cloud threat feeds.

title: Network Security and Segmentation
description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
notes: Isolated private VPC subnets with NAT Gateways for compute workloads.

title: Use of Cryptography and Key Management
description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
notes: AES-256 standard across all database volumes, snapshots, and object storage buckets.

title: Secure Coding and SSDLC Guidelines
description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development to prevent security vulnerabilities.
notes: Automated Dependabot and SAST security gates configured in GitHub Actions workflows.

title: Data-at-Rest Protection & Cryptography
description: Data-at-rest is protected through encryption, hashing, and tokenization techniques complying with NIST standards.
notes: Customer managed KMS keys active on all production RDS databases and S3 buckets.

title: Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing
description: A vulnerability management plan is developed and implemented, including regular automated CVE scans.
notes: Scheduled for automated adversary simulation in upcoming testing cycle.
